interface.signature: def maxCandies(status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: All input lists have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(s in [0, 1] for s in status)
preconditions.description: Each status value is either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for c in candies)
preconditions.description: Each candy count is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k < len(status) for box_keys in keys for k in box_keys)
preconditions.description: Each key index is within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= cb < len(status) for box_contained in containedBoxes for cb in box_contained)
preconditions.description: Each contained box index is within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ib < len(status) for ib in initialBoxes)
preconditions.description: Each initial box index is within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in range(len(status)) if i in reachable_boxes)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the sum of candies in all reachable boxes.
